title: harshly spanish fish bisque
description: a tangy, low-glycemic-friendly spanish fish soup featuring a homemade gherkin relish and fermented fish sauce.

ingredients.name: gherkin relish
ingredients.notes: see below for homemade gherkin relish recipe

ingredients.name: fermented fish sauce
ingredients.notes: store-bought or see below for homemade recipe

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
add the mustard seeds and smoked paprika (if using) and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
add the chopped sole fillets and cook until they start to flake apart, about 3-4 minutes.
add the gherkin relish, fermented fish sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
add 2 cups of fish stock and bring the mixture to a simmer.
reduce the heat to low and let the bisque simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the fish is cooked through.
use an immersion blender to puree the bisque until smooth.
strain the bisque through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan, pressing on the solids to extract as much liquid as possible.
serve the bisque hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs or a dollop of sour cream (optional).
